LensGuard Architecture Specification:
The system consists of an ingestion pipeline, a deterministic heuristic scanner, an unpacker for base64/hex streams, an ML classification layer, and a sanitization module. All components execute in memory without external network calls.

API Authentication Guide:
To authenticate requests, include an Authorization header with a Bearer token: Authorization: Bearer <your_token>. Tokens expire after 24 hours. Refresh tokens must be exchanged at /api/v1/auth/refresh.
